body_json.answer:
**Assessment:** rejected.

The new post's claim that government and media are lying and "must be stopped" closely echoes [T4-009626](#T4-009626), which asserts "MSM LIES" and labels coverage fake news, and [T4-009494](#T4-009494), which accuses mainstream media of "continual lies, cover-ups" and declares lost trust. The anti-government element parallels [T4-004400](#T4-004400), which calls the government "really bad" and says "they should be overthrown long time ago," while [T4-008104](#T4-008104) shares the framing of media as an adversary ("The media is your true enemy"). The main difference is specificity: the new post pairs government and media in one call to action, whereas the retrieved posts target media alone or government alone, and [T4-003068](#T4-003068) is a directed rebuttal telling a named politician to "STOP SPREADING LIES!" rather than a general systemic indictment. All are endorsements of distrust rather than reporting or quotation, though the new post's "must be stopped" is more imperative than the mostly declarative wording of the others.
